ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low macro-level contrast; predominantly low-intensity (dark) pixels with approximately 5% high-intensity (white) pixel coverage localized in discrete spots.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant dark-gray contiguous base layer. Small, circular high-contrast white blobs (stippling) are distributed across both lobes, with higher spatial density at the distal tips and along the trailing edges.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central notch with an estimated pixel angle of 80 degrees; depth occupies roughly 12% of the total vertical bounding box of the fluke.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular high-frequency serration across the entire trailing edge; pixel-amplitude variations range from 2-12 pixels, creating a jagged boundary profile.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave sweep along the trailing edges of both lobes, terminating in slightly upward-tilted distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast white pixel clusters detected at the far left and far right distal tips, forming roughly circular patterns associated with barnacle colonization.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: One distinct, light-gray linear disruption oriented diagonally in the mid-left lobe; several smaller vertical linear marks visible near the medial notch on the left side.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant white scarring and pitting along the distal margins of both lobes; minor irregular truncation at the far right trailing edge tip.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique 'star-field' stippling pattern consisting of hundreds of sub-10-pixel white spots distributed across the dark ventral surface.
